_readme: Editorial composition archetypes for the time-weighted VOD analytics
(pipeline/time_weighting.py). This is a LABEL layered on top of
evidence, never a detection: the pipeline measures which heroes were on
the field and for how long; this file only names groups of line-ups so
seconds can be summed per archetype. A line-up no rule matches is
'unclassified' — it is never forced into the nearest bucket.
Rules are tried in order; the first rule whose 'tanks' list contains the
line-up's tank hero (and whose optional 'requiresAny' is satisfied)
wins. Edit freely; bump 'version' so exports record which rules applied.
